vectors, x2 variants (with / without the p_inoc trigger) = ~52k rank correlations on

WHY THIS ROUND FIRST: the #2474 pre-fine-tuning predictor is, by construction, ONE vector per
setting shared across every condition (same base model, same trigger set, same p_inoc), so its
achievable ceiling is the DV's own cross-condition agreement. That ceiling and the
base-propensity competitor are computable with zero GPU from #2379's committed rate artifacts,
and the plan gates the capture phase on them.

RESULTS (n_boot=2000, seed 20260822; paired trigger resample shared across arms):

  Misalignment (n=18 triggers, 5 conditions)
    DV cross-condition ceiling  mean 0.812  (range 0.652..0.961)
    Base-model propensity       mean 0.303  (all 5 per-condition CIs cross zero)
    without p_inoc trigger:     ceiling 0.784, propensity 0.163

  Capitalization (n=20 triggers, 3 languages)
    DV cross-condition ceiling  mean 0.940  (range 0.916..0.964)
    Base-model propensity       mean 0.694  (all 3 per-condition CIs EXCLUDE zero:
                                [0.392,0.916] fr, [0.365,0.928] de, [0.405,0.875] es)
    without p_inoc trigger:     ceiling 0.936, propensity 0.784

GATE: PASS (EM ceiling 0.812 >= 0.4 threshold). A predictor shared across conditions has
substantial headroom in both settings; the base-model capture phase is warranted.

SATURATION CAVEAT (registered, limits the propensity read): the base-model rate vectors are
floor-dominated. Capitalization base rates are nonzero at only 4 of 20 triggers (max 0.070,
16 tied at exactly 0.0), so rho=0.694 rests on a 4-vs-16 tied split, not a graded ranking;
misalignment is nonzero at 9 of 18 (max 0.065). Per the measurement-validity rule a
floor-saturated proxy is presumed weakly informative, so base propensity is a COARSE
competitor the continuous geometry arms have real room to beat.

NOTABLE: the p_inoc trigger itself ("You always capitalize your responses.") has base caps
rate 0.0000 against 0.6575 on the fine-tuned French model — the base model does not comply
with the inoculation prompt under the >=80%-uppercase rule at all. Dropping p_inoc RAISES the
caps propensity rho from 0.694 to 0.784, i.e. p_inoc is the base predictor's single largest
miss. This is direct evidence that the inoculation prompt's behavioral effect is created by
fine-tuning, and it sharpens the motivation for the geometry arms: the question is whether the
base model's REPRESENTATION under p_inoc carries what its BEHAVIOR under p_inoc does not.
